headings.usage: Use Outfit for all dashboard module titles, risk scores, KPI numbers, and prominent labels. Avoid generic sans like Inter. Use tracking-tight for H1-H2.

body.usage: Use IBM Plex Sans for all tabular data, transaction histories, metadata, subtext, and audit logs to convey auditable, bank-grade precision.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use True Grey base surfaces (not pure black) to reduce eye strain. Use borderless cards with elevation tokens (subtle box-shadows on hover, 1px top borders).
visual_enhancers.textures: Incorporate subtle noise overlays or abstract mesh patterns for the login/hero sections to enforce a 'cybersecurity-serious' mood.
visual_enhancers.badges: Risk badges must use distinct color variants. Avoid garish solid background blobs; prefer 10% opacity backgrounds with 20% opacity borders and saturated text.
visual_enhancers.data_freshness: Include 'data freshness' indicators (e.g., 'Updated 5s ago') near critical tables to convey real-time system health.

layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid (Mode B). Base grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gaps: gap-4 or gap-6.
layouts.navigation: Collapsible left-sidebar with a global top ribbon (Search, Bell, Profile). Top-left quadrant reserved for North Star metric (Total Payment Risk or Protected Volume).
layouts.cards: Subtle roundness (max 8px border-radius). No generic Bootstrap-style cards. Ensure uniform card heights using flex/grid stretching.

components.shadcn_overrides: Override standard Shadcn borders to be extremely subtle (border-white/10). Limit card usage; use pure HTML/Tailwind for custom layouts where Shadcn feels too generic.
components.tables: Use dense padding for audit trails and invoice scanners to fit more data. Highlight anomalies inline using the 'Suspected Fraud' or 'Critical' risk colors.
components.forms: Inputs must have a dark elevated background, border-white/10, and high-contrast text. Focus rings should use the 'primary' or 'accent' color.

motion.micro_interactions: Hover states must lift slightly (-translate-y-0.5) and brighten borders. Exclude transforms from universal transitions. Use staggered entrance animations for feed/list items.
motion.focus_states: Focus states must have HIGHER contrast than default state. Do not rely on color alone; use focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/50.

accessibility.contrast: Text below 18px needs 4.5:1 ratio. Large text needs 3:1.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case role-based (e.g., data-testid='verify-payment-btn').

media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react for sharp, technical dashboard icons.

images.description: Male user profile picture for top right nav or audit logs
Female user profile picture for audit logs / Maker-Checker approvals
Dark woven mesh texture for login screen or command center header background overlay (low opacity)
Close up of invoice document for the Smart Invoice Scanner module preview
Abstract bank logo for Vendor Trust Passport

instructions_to_main_agent: Step 1: Set up Tailwind config to strictly follow the color palette provided (background: #0B0F19, etc). Overwrite index.css dark mode variables.
Step 2: Embed the Google Fonts (Outfit and IBM Plex Sans) into the index.html or index.css.
Step 3: Scaffold a Layout component featuring a collapsible left sidebar and top ribbon with data-testid attributes.
Step 4: Implement Dashboard route first. Ensure the 'North Star' metric is top-left. Use dense grid layouts. Never center everything.
Step 5: Implement the Multi-step Verify Payment workflow. Use the 'IBM Plex Sans' font for data tables.
Step 6: Build the Smart Invoice Scanner with drag-and-drop. Use the invoice image provided.
Step 7: Apply Risk Badges utilizing the 'risk_spectrum' colors in the Vendor Trust Passport and Audit Trail modules.
CRITICAL: Do not use complete transparent backgrounds for header/overlays. Use backdrop-blur with a dark semi-transparent fill.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Create a distinctive, bank-grade cybersecurity frontend.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. Use the provided images.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js/tsx (use appropriate JS/TS extension based on project setup).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
